definitions.explanation: Romantic love between two people, encompassing the feelings, relationship, and experience of being in love. Refers to the concept of romantic love in general or a specific romantic relationship.

{恋愛|れんあい}⟦{結婚|けっこん}→結婚：02514_kekkon⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{見合|みあ}い→見合い：14159_miai⟧⟦{結婚|けっこん}→結婚：02514_kekkon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦どちら→どちら：00927_dochira⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧です⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。

notes:
{恋愛|れんあい} combines ⟦{恋|こい}→恋：02208_koi⟧ (love, romantic longing) and ⟦{愛|あい}→愛：02370_ai⟧ (love, affection) to form a compound meaning romantic love.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {恋愛|れんあい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to be in a romantic relationship, to have a romance
- {恋愛|れんあい}⟦{結婚|けっこん}→結婚：02514_kekkon⟧: love marriage (as opposed to arranged marriage)
- {恋愛|れんあい}⟦{小説|しょうせつ}→小説：01434_shousetsu⟧: romance novel
- {恋愛|れんあい}⟦{感情|かんじょう}→感情：00171_kanjou⟧: romantic feelings
- {恋愛|れんあい}⟦{相談|そうだん}→相談：02089_soudan⟧: relationship advice
- {恋愛|れんあい}⟦{対象|たいしょう}→対象：03393_taishou⟧: romantic interest, object of one's love

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {恋愛|れんあい}: romantic love (the concept or experience as a whole)
- ⟦{恋|こい}→恋：02208_koi⟧: love, being in love (more emotional, longing-focused)
- ⟦{愛|あい}→愛：02370_ai⟧: love (broader; includes familial, platonic)
- ⟦{愛情|あいじょう}→愛情：01673_aijou⟧: affection, love (emotional warmth, not limited to romance)
